narr: Thunderstorms across Cochise County and Santa Cruz County resulted in areas of flash flooding.
ev: Reports of flash flooding with running water over roadway at the intersection of Sopori Wash and W Arivaca Rd.

Reports of flash flooding on roadways and stranded vehicles near Washington Ave and Golf Course Road in Douglas. There was also a car stuck in flooded roadway at Primrose St and Washington Ave in Douglas.
lsr: Car stuck in flooded roadway at Primrose St and Washington Ave.
Flooding on roadways and stranded vehicles near Washington Ave and Golf Course Road.
